ClipSphere is an inferred descriptive name for arm9:0x020150e8, not a recovered ROM name. Scalar Fix12i radius expands near/far bounds and is compared to the four normalized frustum-plane distances. The optional hint supplies the first side-plane index and caches a rejecting side plane. The native member retains opt_propagation off, the goto-shaped arithmetic, return -viewZ or INT_MAX, and the full 0x478-byte body; no claim that existing scalar-view/layout debt in Actor is solved.
